title: Clarifying Local Cache and Disk Usage for a team

question.author: member_276
question.body: Before I explain local cache and disk usage to my team, what should I verify in the official guide?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Sync Engine documentation says: The cache never counts against your CloudBox storage quota — it is a local, per-device artifact only. The client keeps a local cache of recently changed blocks to make syncs faster; this cache can grow large on busy folders. You can clear it at any time under Settings > Advanced without affecting your files. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
